summary: Transit Finance suffered a cross chain DeFi exploit that drained approximately one point eight eight million dollars in DAI from the protocol through a smart contract vulnerability. Security researchers traced the stolen funds on chain while the protocol urged users to revoke token approvals linked to the platform.
user_mistake: granted token approvals to a vulnerable cross chain DeFi protocol
prevention: revoke unused token approvals after interacting with DeFi platforms/limit wallet permissions granted to cross chain protocols
